text: The same question as 0197, a fixed code alphabet first and a shuffle after, for the three largest families of shuffles, whose builders live inside compiled code.
Each library's own builder, unchanged, with its per-route check replaced by the code-alphabet check: repeated known letters must land on one carved letter, different ones on different.
None of 243 million routes passes on K4 or any copy. With 0106 and 0197, every move the project has built is closed for a code alphabet first. F9.1 closed.
